'''Astara''' was the sixth Queen of [[Andor]], succeeding Queen [[Maragaine]] in {{Fy|1073}}.

==History==
It is not known if Astara was Maragaine's daughter, but it is known that she was also a descendant of Queen [[Ishara Casalain]], the founder of the kingdom of Andor.

Astara ruled for twelve years (FY 1073-[[FY 1085|85]]) and was succeeded by [[Telaisien]].
